Unit 3 • Let's celebrate

Productive Vocabulary

Same style as Unit 1 and Unit 2: pictures, pronunciation, meaning and example sentences.
🎙 US English voice
Choose the US voice that sounds most natural. The page will remember the choice.
How to study: Look at the picture → say the word → press 🔊 → read the meaning → read both sentences → cover the word and try to spell it.
Part A: Picture words (1–25)
These words come from the productive vocabulary pages with pictures.
1
eat traditional food
eet truh-DISH-uh-nuhl food
Meaning: to eat food that is special to a culture or celebration.
1. We eat traditional food at Lunar New Year.
2. My grandma cooks traditional food for the family.
2
give presents
giv PREZ-uhnts
Meaning: to give gifts to other people.
1. We give presents on birthdays.
2. I want to give presents to my friends.
3
make special food
mayk SPESH-uhl food
Meaning: to cook food for a special day or event.
1. Mum will make special food tonight.
2. We make special food for the festival.
4
play party games
play PAR-tee gaymz
Meaning: to play games at a party.
1. The children play party games at the party.
2. We like to play party games together.
5
put up decorations
put up dek-uh-RAY-shunz
Meaning: to hang or place decorations around a place.
1. We put up decorations in the classroom.
2. Dad helped me put up decorations.
6
see a parade
see uh puh-RAYD
Meaning: to watch a public celebration in the street.
1. We went to see a parade.
2. Many people see the parade every year.
7
throw streamers
throh STREE-merz
Meaning: to throw long paper ribbons in celebration.
1. The children throw streamers in the air.
2. We throw streamers at the party.
8
wear a costume
wair uh KOS-toom
Meaning: to put on special clothes for fun or for a show.
1. She will wear a costume to the party.
2. The boy wears a star costume.
9
cartoon
kar-TOON
Meaning: a funny animated show or drawing.
1. I watch a cartoon after school.
2. This cartoon is very funny.
10
channel
CHAN-uhl
Meaning: a TV station or a place on television.
1. My favourite channel shows cartoons.
2. Please change the channel.
11
chess
ches
Meaning: a board game played by two people.
1. My brother teaches me chess.
2. We play chess in the club.
12
collect
kuh-LEKT
Meaning: to bring things together or gather them.
1. I collect stamps at home.
2. Please collect the books.
13
concert
KON-surt
Meaning: a live music performance.
1. We went to a concert last night.
2. The concert starts at seven o'clock.
14
diary
DYE-uh-ree
Meaning: a book where you write about your life or daily events.
1. I write in my diary every night.
2. My diary is in my bag.
15
drum
drum
Meaning: a musical instrument you hit to make sound.
1. He can play the drum.
2. The drum is very loud.
16
festival
FES-tuh-vuhl
Meaning: a special time of celebration.
1. The Spring Festival is fun.
2. We enjoy the food at the festival.
17
golf
golf
Meaning: a sport in which you hit a ball into holes.
1. My uncle plays golf on Sunday.
2. Golf is played on a big field.
18
hotel
hoh-TEL
Meaning: a place where people stay when travelling.
1. We stayed in a hotel in Tokyo.
2. The hotel has a big swimming pool.
19
instrument
IN-struh-muhnt
Meaning: a tool used to make music.
1. A piano is an instrument.
2. He can play many instruments.
20
invitation / invite
in-vuh-TAY-shun / in-VYTE
Meaning: an invitation is a card or message asking someone to come; invite is the verb.
1. I got an invitation to the party.
2. Please invite your classmates.
21
join (a club)
join
Meaning: to become part of a group or club.
1. I want to join the art club.
2. She joined the music club.
22
magazine
mag-uh-ZEEN
Meaning: a colourful book or paper with articles and pictures.
1. My dad reads a sports magazine.
2. There is a new magazine on the table.
23
match (US: game)
match
Meaning: a game or sports contest.
1. We watched a football match.
2. The match was exciting.
24
meet
meet
Meaning: to see or come together with someone.
1. I will meet my friend after school.
2. Nice to meet you.
25
member
MEM-bur
Meaning: a person who belongs to a group.
1. He is a member of the chess club.
2. Every member must help the team.
Part B: Definition words (26–35)
These words are productive words shown with definitions instead of pictures.
26
🏘️
community
kuh-MYOO-nuh-tee
Meaning: a group of people living in the same area.
1. The community came together to clean the park.
2. People in our community are friendly.
27
💥
impact
IM-pakt
Meaning: the effect or influence of one thing on another.
1. The impact of the storm was severe.
2. Reading has a big impact on children.
28
🏆
successful
suhk-SES-fuhl
Meaning: achieving desired results.
1. She is a successful entrepreneur.
2. He was successful in the competition.
29
🙂
attitude
AT-uh-tood
Meaning: a way of thinking or feeling about something.
1. His positive attitude inspired everyone.
2. Good attitude is important at school.
30
🥂
toast
tohst
Meaning: a ritual expression of goodwill or honour, usually with a drink.
1. Everyone raised their glasses for a toast.
2. Dad made a toast at the wedding.
31
🎓
ceremony
SER-uh-moh-nee
Meaning: a formal event celebrating a special occasion.
1. The graduation ceremony was held outdoors.
2. We watched the opening ceremony.
32
✨
gala
GAY-luh
Meaning: a festive celebration, often formal and elaborate.
1. They attended a gala to raise funds for charity.
2. The school held a gala dinner.
33
🎉
bash
bash
Meaning: a lively party or celebration.
1. She threw a big bash for her birthday.
2. We had a fun bash at home.
34
🥁
parade
puh-RAYD
Meaning: a public procession celebrating an event.
1. The parade attracted thousands of spectators.
2. We saw a parade in the city.
35
🎓
commencement
kuh-MENS-muhnt
Meaning: a ceremony marking the beginning of something, especially graduation.
1. The commencement ceremony was inspiring for graduates.
2. Her sister spoke at the commencement.
